Good people shouldn’t be the integration layer.

If your team spends the day copying, checking, and chasing information between systems, the workflow is asking for a better one. You have probably heard all four of these this week.

  • Slow lead response

    Calls, forms, and texts land in different places, and the job goes to whoever answers first.

    “Did anyone call back the form that came in Saturday?”

  • Dispatch handoffs

    CSRs and dispatchers spend hours moving context between phones, inboxes, technicians, and customers.

    “Can you text me the gate code again?”

  • Quotes that go quiet

    Follow-up depends on someone remembering, instead of a system that knows what should happen next.

    “Did we ever hear back on the Miller estimate?”

  • Reporting by spreadsheet

    Leaders wait on hand-assembled numbers instead of seeing what changed, where, and why.

    “I’ll have last month’s numbers by Thursday.”
